description: The Debug Adapter Protocol server OpenMind Studio uses to debug Node.js. Runs on your Node.js, portable first.

features.label: Debug adapter
features.missingNote: The adapter is not in this install. Use Repair to reinstall it.

notes: Microsoft's vscode-js-debug DAP server (the js-debug-dap release on GitHub; SHA256 from the release's asset digest). Nothing is added to PATH: the adapter is started only for a debug session, listening on 127.0.0.1.
